title: Why Is the Ocean Salty?
hook: Rivers carry tiny bits of rock to the sea.
narration: Rivers carry tiny bits of rock to the sea.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Is the Ocean Salty.
Let me show you that in 3D.
The sun lifts fresh water as vapor.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Salt stays behind, so the ocean tastes salty.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Rivers carry tiny bits of rock to the sea.
The pictures today are a new wave world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why is the ocean salty.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
